name: Kemono no Sumu Kousha
source:
Ikuro Makita is a recently transferred professor at girls' high school. He gets a request from the director to investigate the circumstances of his son death that's reported to be a suicide.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
真田郁郎是一名刚转职到女子高中的教师。校长请他调查一名学生死亡的情况，这名学生据称是自杀。

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
